title: My Home Hero
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Tetsuo Tosu, a mild salaryman and mystery-novel fan, discovers his daughter Reika's boyfriend is abusing her and has killed past girlfriends, and kills him. The dead man's father runs a yakuza branch, so Tetsuo and his wife Kasen must hide the body and outwit the gang using his detective-novel knowledge. Later arcs jump ahead years, with Reika becoming a police investigator and Kasen's past in a rural cult coming into play.
life_message: A parent's love may drive him to anything, and the story weighs that devotion against the spiralling cost of the crimes it requires.

folkways.japan: Contrasts an ordinary salaryman household with yakuza hierarchy and a closed rural cult, both recognizable Japanese crime-fiction settings.

winners_losers: The Tosu family survives its early arcs; yakuza members lose. Sympathy goes to family loyalty, with the cost shown through Reika ending up on the side of the law.
